title: game/land.json
description: The land rules (Y09): the regions where placing blocks is refused, the regions where a plot may lie, and the plot's size, price and slope. Loaded by LandData (Vocaterra.Game.Core); GameDataValidator checks the site names against scene.json and the numbers (LandValidator).

generated_by.description: Who or what wrote the file (hand-authored).

protectedSites.description: Discs round scene sites where placing is refused (the village, Luna's camp).

site.description: A key of scene.json's sites; the site needs a radius.

protection.description: Which hint the player reads when a block is refused here.

margin.description: Blocks added to the site's radius (and blend) for the disc.

includeBlend.description: Whether the site's blend is part of the disc (the village's is, so the protection follows the scene's ground work). Default false.

protectedBlocks.description: Columns within margin of a column holding one of the named blocks (the roads, the bridge).

margin.description: Blocks of square margin round each such column.

eligible.description: Discs round scene sites where a plot may lie (the two meadows).

maxSlope.description: The most the highest and the lowest ground of the plot may differ, in blocks.
